item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I really enjoyed letting the narrative take me where it would - from terrified people, to a man at a haberdashery, to the off-hand remembrance of Motormouth being there, and especially to the reveal that it's all probably a hoax.

I did catch a single spelling error - "succame" looks like it was supposed to be "succumbed" - but other than that, it was the enjoyable read that I've come to expect from Dread & Circuses.
